###############################################################################
# Data sources
#
# These only read static provider metadata (account id, partition, region) so
# that ARNs can be constructed without hardcoding an account id.
###############################################################################

data "aws_caller_identity" "current" {}

data "aws_partition" "current" {}

data "aws_region" "current" {}

###############################################################################
# Locals
###############################################################################

locals {
  iam_user_name   = "TJ"
  iam_policy_name = "GlacierEFSEC2"

  account_id = data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id
  partition  = data.aws_partition.current.partition
  region     = data.aws_region.current.name

  glacier_vault_arn   = "arn:${local.partition}:glacier:${local.region}:${local.account_id}:vaults/*"
  efs_file_system_arn = "arn:${local.partition}:elasticfilesystem:${local.region}:${local.account_id}:file-system/*"

  common_tags = {
    ManagedBy = "Terraform"
    Purpose   = "EC2-EFS-Glacier-administration"
  }
}

###############################################################################
# IAM policy document: EC2 management + EFS client mount + Glacier vault /
# multipart-upload permissions.
#
# No statement uses "*" for both Action and Resource.
###############################################################################

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "glacier_efs_ec2" {
  statement {
    sid    = "EC2Management"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "ec2:AllocateAddress",
      "ec2:AssociateAddress",
      "ec2:AssociateIamInstanceProfile",
      "ec2:AttachVolume",
      "ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress",
      "ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress",
      "ec2:CreateImage",
      "ec2:CreateKeyPair",
      "ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate",
      "ec2:CreateNetworkInterface",
      "ec2:CreateSecurityGroup",
      "ec2:CreateSnapshot",
      "ec2:CreateTags",
      "ec2:CreateVolume",
      "ec2:DeleteKeyPair",
      "ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface",
      "ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup",
      "ec2:DeleteSnapshot",
      "ec2:DeleteTags",
      "ec2:DeleteVolume",
      "ec2:DeregisterImage",
      "ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes",
      "ec2:DescribeAddresses",
      "ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones",
      "ec2:DescribeImages",
      "ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus",
      "ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes",
      "ec2:DescribeInstances",
      "ec2:DescribeKeyPairs",
      "ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates",
      "ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces",
      "ec2:DescribeRegions",
      "ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups",
      "ec2:DescribeSnapshots",
      "ec2:DescribeSubnets",
      "ec2:DescribeTags",
      "ec2:DescribeVolumes",
      "ec2:DescribeVpcs",
      "ec2:DetachVolume",
      "ec2:DisassociateAddress",
      "ec2:ImportKeyPair",
      "ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute",
      "ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute",
      "ec2:ModifyVolume",
      "ec2:MonitorInstances",
      "ec2:RebootInstances",
      "ec2:ReleaseAddress",
      "ec2:RunInstances",
      "ec2:StartInstances",
      "ec2:StopInstances",
      "ec2:TerminateInstances",
      "ec2:UnmonitorInstances",
    ]

    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "EFSClientMount"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "elasticfilesystem:ClientMount",
      "elasticfilesystem:ClientRootAccess",
      "elasticfilesystem:ClientWrite",
    ]

    resources = [local.efs_file_system_arn]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "EFSDescribe"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "elasticfilesystem:DescribeAccessPoints",
      "elasticfilesystem:DescribeFileSystems",
      "elasticfilesystem:DescribeMountTargetSecurityGroups",
      "elasticfilesystem:DescribeMountTargets",
    ]

    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "GlacierVaultAndArchiveOperations"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "glacier:AbortMultipartUpload",
      "glacier:AbortVaultLock",
      "glacier:CompleteMultipartUpload",
      "glacier:CompleteVaultLock",
      "glacier:CreateVault",
      "glacier:DeleteArchive",
      "glacier:DeleteVault",
      "glacier:DescribeJob",
      "glacier:DescribeVault",
      "glacier:GetJobOutput",
      "glacier:GetVaultAccessPolicy",
      "glacier:GetVaultLock",
      "glacier:InitiateJob",
      "glacier:InitiateMultipartUpload",
      "glacier:InitiateVaultLock",
      "glacier:ListJobs",
      "glacier:ListMultipartUploads",
      "glacier:ListParts",
      "glacier:SetVaultAccessPolicy",
      "glacier:UploadArchive",
      "glacier:UploadMultipartPart",
    ]

    resources = [local.glacier_vault_arn]
  }

  statement {
    sid       = "GlacierListVaults"
    effect    = "Allow"
    actions   = ["glacier:ListVaults"]
    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

###############################################################################
# IAM user "TJ"
###############################################################################

resource "aws_iam_user" "tj" {
  name = local.iam_user_name
  path = "/"

  tags = merge(local.common_tags, {
    Name = local.iam_user_name
  })

  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}

###############################################################################
# Custom IAM policy "GlacierEFSEC2"
###############################################################################

resource "aws_iam_policy" "glacier_efs_ec2" {
  name        = local.iam_policy_name
  description = "Grants EC2 management permissions plus EFS client-mount access and Glacier vault / multipart-upload permissions."
  policy      = data.aws_iam_policy_document.glacier_efs_ec2.json

  tags = merge(local.common_tags, {
    Name = local.iam_policy_name
  })

  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}

###############################################################################
# Attach the policy to the user
###############################################################################

resource "aws_iam_user_policy_attachment" "glacier_efs_ec2" {
  user       = aws_iam_user.tj.name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.glacier_efs_ec2.arn
}

###############################################################################
# Outputs
###############################################################################

output "iam_user_name" {
  description = "Name of the created IAM user."
  value       = aws_iam_user.tj.name
}

output "iam_user_arn" {
  description = "ARN of the created IAM user."
  value       = aws_iam_user.tj.arn
}

output "iam_policy_arn" {
  description = "ARN of the GlacierEFSEC2 policy attached to the user."
  value       = aws_iam_policy.glacier_efs_ec2.arn
}

  statement {
    sid    = "AcmCertificateManagement"

  statement {
    sid    = "CloudFrontDistributionManagement"
    effect = "Allow"

      "cloudfront:CreateDistribution",
      "cloudfront:CreateInvalidation",
      "cloudfront:DeleteDistribution",
      "cloudfront:GetDistribution",
      "cloudfront:GetDistributionConfig",
      "cloudfront:ListDistributions",
      "cloudfront:ListInvalidations",
      "cloudfront:TagResource",
      "cloudfront:UntagResource",
      "cloudfront:UpdateDistribution",

      "iam:PassRole",
      "iam:PutRolePolicy",
      "iam:TagRole",
      "iam:UntagRole",
      "iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy",

    resources = [
      "arn:${local.partition}:iam::${local.account_id}:role/*",
      "arn:${local.partition}:iam::${local.account_id}:policy/*",
    ]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "LambdaFunctionManagement"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "lambda:AddPermission",
      "lambda:CreateFunction",
      "lambda:DeleteFunction",
      "lambda:GetFunction",
      "lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration",
      "lambda:GetPolicy",
      "lambda:ListFunctions",
      "lambda:ListVersionsByFunction",
      "lambda:PublishVersion",
      "lambda:RemovePermission",
      "lambda:TagResource",
      "lambda:UntagResource",
      "lambda:UpdateFunctionCode",
      "lambda:UpdateFunctionConfiguration",
    ]
    resources = ["arn:${local.partition}:lambda:${local.region}:${local.account_id}:function:*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "Route53RecordManagement"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "route53:ChangeResourceRecordSets",
      "route53:GetChange",
      "route53:GetHostedZone",
      "route53:ListHostedZones",

      "s3:GetObject",
      "s3:ListBucket",
      "s3:PutBucketPolicy",
      "s3:PutObject",
      "s3:PutObjectAcl",
    ]
    resources = [
      "arn:${local.partition}:s3:::*",
      "arn:${local.partition}:s3:::*/*",
    ]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "SqsQueueManagement"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "sqs:CreateQueue",
      "sqs:DeleteQueue",
      "sqs:GetQueueAttributes",
      "sqs:GetQueueUrl",
      "sqs:ListQueues",
      "sqs:ReceiveMessage",
      "sqs:SendMessage",
      "sqs:SetQueueAttributes",
    ]
    resources = ["arn:${local.partition}:sqs:${local.region}:${local.account_id}:*"]
  }
}

final_template:
variable "cloudhealth_account_id" {
  description = "AWS account ID of the CloudHealth SaaS platform that is allowed to assume the cross-account role."
  type        = string
  default     = "454464851268"
}

variable "cloudhealth_external_id" {
  description = "External ID that CloudHealth must supply in the sts:AssumeRole call (provided per-tenant by CloudHealth)."
  type        = string
  default     = "cloudhealth-external-id"
}

locals {
  role_name   = "CloudHealth-IAM-Role"
  policy_name = "CloudHealth-IAM-Role"

  tags = {
    Name      = "CloudHealth-IAM-Role"
    ManagedBy = "Terraform"
    Purpose   = "CloudHealth cross-account read-only cost and usage analysis"
  }
}

data "aws_partition" "current" {}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "cloudhealth_assume_role" {
  statement {
    sid     = "AllowCloudHealthAssumeRole"
    effect  = "Allow"
    actions = ["sts:AssumeRole"]

    principals {
      type = "AWS"
      identifiers = [
        "arn:${data.aws_partition.current.partition}:iam::${var.cloudhealth_account_id}:root"
      ]
    }

    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "sts:ExternalId"
      values   = [var.cloudhealth_external_id]
    }
  }
}
